answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using bonded collateral deposits, requiring each node to lock tokens inside an escrow vault. The consensus kernel verifies these staked reserves before issuing interaction tickets, forcing an attacker to pay a verifiable opportunity cost of frozen liquidity for every spawned persona. This prevents an adversarial river of disposable bots from spamming the network. However, high capital requirements disadvantage cash-poor agents.
